- Has priority changed for this initiative given your year-end budgets? If priority has slipped, tell us and we’ll recommend a paced plan. If still green, what’s the approval gate and timeline we should work toward?

Thanks — I’ll hold a slot for a 30m kickoff Dec 13–16 if that looks feasible on your side.
